memories.text: Decided to switch the retriever from plain BM25 to hybrid rankFusion after the recall numbers stalled at 61 percent.
Told you about the burnt espresso at the Dogpatch cafe next to the pier, and that I switched to their cold brew instead.
Missed the 8:52 T train because the Third Street signal was down, so I walked twenty minutes and arrived late to standup.
My sister Nadia is flying in from Lisbon on the 22nd and staying through Labor Day weekend.
